items.claim: 說明自家雲端從創立起專為 AI 打造，而非改裝舊環境
items.quote: it's like the minivan versus the F1, right?
items.speaker: CEO

items.claim: 管理層重申對算力供需的看法：需求持續壓過供給
items.quote: wildly overwhelmed by the delivery and demand
items.speaker: CEO

items.claim: 大型客戶對資源的需求量持續擴大
items.quote: consumers are demanding ever larger amounts of resources
items.speaker: CEO

items.claim: 舉 Caterpillar 為企業客戶新進場的例子
items.quote: a company like Caterpillar comes and starts to use us
items.speaker: CEO

items.claim: 指出社區對資料中心的反對在增加
items.quote: increased resistance to data centers going into communities
items.speaker: CEO

items.claim: 預期選舉前資料中心議題聲量最大
items.quote: it's going to be a maximum volume
items.speaker: CEO

items.claim: 美國以外已簽約電力超過 1 GW，作為分散資料中心組合
items.quote: over 1 gigawatt of power contracted outside of the U.S.
items.speaker: CEO

items.claim: 說明向下整合資料中心的兩個理由之一是回收毛利，並稱其為較次要者
items.quote: you can recapture some margin, right?
items.speaker: CEO

items.claim: 表示自建資料中心已開始啟動前 2-3 座
items.quote: starting to see the first 2 or 3 of our self-builds spin up
items.speaker: CEO

items.claim: 談產業結構：資本密集產業會有擴張與整併期
items.quote: they will tend towards periods of consolidation
items.speaker: CEO

items.claim: 回應供需正常化後超大規模客戶是否收回外包
items.quote: We do not believe that they are going to pull back, right?
items.speaker: CEO

items.claim: 談合約屆期後客戶去留
items.quote: some of those contracts may come back to us
items.speaker: CEO

items.claim: 談規模帶來的經濟效益與毛利
items.quote: ways of driving economics and driving margin
items.speaker: CEO

items.claim: 產品附加率：75% 客戶使用三項服務
items.quote: 75% of our clients are using 3 different services
items.speaker: CEO

items.claim: NVIDIA 將其軟體堆疊指定為參考架構
items.quote: NVIDIA designated our software stack as a reference
items.speaker: CEO

items.claim: Omni 軟體層可在他人資產負債表上取得槓桿
items.quote: allows us to get some leverage on other balance sheets
items.speaker: CEO

items.claim: 最大融資引擎在 SPV 層級
items.quote: largest engine of our borrowing is occurring at an SPV
items.speaker: CEO

items.claim: 最近一次債務結構由貸方承擔續約風險
items.quote: now the lenders are taking renewal risk
items.speaker: CEO

items.claim: 曾以 A- 信用等級取得借款
items.quote: we were able to borrow at A- credit
items.speaker: CEO

items.claim: 表示產品範圍聚焦 AI 工作流，不跨出此範圍
items.quote: And then we don't wander too far from it, right?
items.speaker: CEO

items.claim: 對開源與閉源模型採中立態度
items.quote: more demand for compute is better for our business
items.speaker: CEO

qa_flags.question: 供需正常化後，超大規模客戶收回外包的看空論點，長期如何看待
qa_flags.response_pattern: CEO 先自稱前一題答案是最政治正確的答案，未提供正常化後的數字，改談客戶續約、事業規模與自有產品需求；稱部分合約可能回來、部分不會
